PAGES 5-17 ARE THIRTEEN PAGES OF WELLS FARGO STATEMENTS AND A WELLS FARGO 'StoreVision' ACCOUNT-LIST SCREENSHOT covering December 2009 - December 2010, and PAGE 18 IS THE COUNTY'S 'Dissolution of a Candidate Campaign Committee' notice, signed by the committee secretary and clerk-stamped RECEIVED JAN 05 2011. Nothing was transcribed from the bank pages or the dissolution notice - they are supporting material, not schedules - and the account numbers and mailing address they carry were not read or recorded. The whole reported activity of the period is one payment: the campaign's remaining $1,372.71 given to the Rescue Mission of Salt Lake as a charitable contribution, the purpose cell citing the county ordinance ('See 2.72A.201') under which a dissolving committee disposes of its balance.
